observations.finding: Analyze predicted endpoint coordinates in the supplied world frame, in angstroms, rather than current physical atom positions. Observations cover the 50 exact nodes t=0.00 through 0.49 within the declared [0,0.5] learning window. Regional moments equally average children within extant parent and score stratum, then equally average batches; survival and information audits use 14 independent batches. Terminal score time 0.99 and terminal state time 1.0 are distinct from these early endpoint forecasts.

Whole-window high-minus-low selection contrasts favor a geometric pattern with lower shape_xx (-0.495 z; CI [-0.648,-0.320], q=0.000813; negative in 13/14 batches) and shape_yy (-0.513; CI [-0.620,-0.424], q=0.0000149; negative in all batches), higher pair_kernel_1.5/2.5/3.5 (+0.562/+0.631/+0.540; q<=0.000146; positive in all batches), and lower pair_kernel_7.0 (-0.485; CI [-0.617,-0.357], q=0.000146; negative in all batches). Landmark_00 softmin is lower (-0.481, q=0.000813), while occupancy3 is higher (+0.545, q=0.000235), with unanimous batch directions. These are associations of endpoint geometric proxies with selection, not interaction energies.

Parent-debiased regional selection contrasts also support greater landmark_00 soft_mass (+0.639 z; CI [0.492,0.791], q=0.000188; 14/14 positive batches) and lower local_cyy in regions 00, 07 and 16 (-0.575/-0.646/-0.672; q<=0.000131; all negative batches). Local_dy is region-specific: region 06 is positive (+0.425; CI [0.339,0.515], q=0.000115; all positive batches), while region 12 is negative (-0.529; CI [-0.677,-0.389], q=0.000411; all negative batches). A single global y direction would erase these contrasts.

The complete empirical node sequences are nonmonotone. Landmark_00 soft_mass contrast is -0.366 z at t=0, peaks at +1.641 at t=0.16, and returns to -0.275 at t=0.49; consecutive ten-node means spanning the full window are +0.410,+1.030,+1.154,+0.455,+0.051. Region 07 local_cyy reaches -1.321 at t=0.24 but ends +0.296; region 06 local_dy rises from +0.326 to +1.270 at t=0.20 and ends -0.334; region 12 local_dy is mostly negative and ends +0.166. These descriptive reversals limit a constant directional target. Node-specific confidence intervals are not supplied, so individual reversals are not independently significant effects.

Levels, changes in selection enrichment, and parent-edge increments are different estimands. Region 01 local_dz has near-zero integrated enrichment (-0.013 z, q=0.923) but positive enrichment-change rate (+1.621, CI [1.097,2.185], q=0.00196; 14/14 positive batches). Region 04 local_cyz similarly has near-zero level (-0.010, q=0.932) but positive enrichment-change rate (+2.276, CI [1.474,3.152], q=0.00346; 13/14 positive batches); its parent-edge rate is unsupported (-0.963, q=0.709). Conversely region 04 local_cxx has a negative parent-edge contrast rate (-4.596, CI [-6.242,-3.012], q=0.00325; all negative batches) and negative enrichment (-0.391, q=0.0304). Rates describe endpoint forecast changes on the supplied clock, not physical atom velocity.

The landmark_00 softmin success-minus-failure increment contrast is negative (-4.914 standardized rate units; CI [-6.855,-2.616], q=0.0461; negative in 13/14 batches). The related occupancy3 increment (+4.277, q=0.0811) and pair_kernel_2.5 increment (+3.965, q=0.208) do not survive the supplied multiplicity correction. A supported selection level does not establish a beneficial forecast movement rate.

Terminal-survival enrichment is weaker than local selection support: landmark_00 soft_mass is +0.365 z (CI [0.200,0.515], q=0.1204; 12/14 positive batches), and region 05 local_czz is -0.419 (CI [-0.596,-0.215], q=0.1204). No supplied survival field/measure test has q<0.05 after joint BH correction over 400 tests. Coverage is limited: 349/700 batch-nodes have fewer than three ancestors and 531/700 fewer than six; teacher counts are only 17-28 per node, with at most two teachers per batch. Survival is not final affinity and repeated descendants are not independent confirmations.

The selected compressed temporal fits cannot be treated as reliable runtime time functions: none of the 24 audited fields allows Legendre runtime use. Relative node RMSE ranges from 0.386 to 0.931, exceeding the supplied <=0.35 rule, and several fields have strong node-sign conflicts. For example shape_yy has last empirical contrast +0.163 versus fitted -0.513, while landmark_06 occupancy5 has +0.270 versus fitted -0.365. Whole-window evidence must not replace the empirical time sequence.

Sparse geometric compression loses some teacher-choice information. With leave-one-batch exclusion, top-four teacher overlap is 0.470 (batch-bootstrap CI [0.427,0.515]); excess fixed-frame RMS is 0.081 A (CI [0.070,0.092]); compressed-choice fixed-frame RMS is 0.564 A and proper-rigid RMS is 0.529 A. Chosen-teacher score correlations are small (compressed 0.102, full 0.064). This supports preserving coordinate detail as a candidate design consideration, but the audit does not evaluate the full score-weighted reward, its endpoint VJP, or causal final-affinity benefit.

The incumbent program_20 is a reasonable retained candidate for paired validation: its discovery mean_pic50_delta is +0.2303 and valid-rate change +0.01, with supplied MMFF relief per heavy atom median/p90 0.4769/0.9546. Program_3 has a very similar mean delta (+0.2293) but p90 1.2526; program_19 has +0.2128 and p90 0.9079; program_8 has +0.1390 and p90 0.7310. Program_4 has a higher best-valid score (8.5580 versus incumbent 8.2371), but valid-rate change -0.02. These tradeoffs separate means, validity, best cases and physical tails; all are adaptive reused discovery summaries without independent validation or comparative uncertainty.

hypotheses: Retain registered program_20 unchanged as the one candidate for an independent paired generation comparison. The supplied registry identifies endpoint_pointcloud with mixture_temperature=0.5, native_rms_ratio=0.33, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2=4.0, teacher_neighbors=4, teacher_score_beta=2.0 and time_ramp_power=0.0. Its discovery mean and physical-tail summaries justify testing, not a claim of superiority. Judge final predicted target affinity over all attempts and failures and assess strain means and tails separately; paired independent-batch uncertainty must resolve the objective [quality:program_20; quality:program_3; quality:program_19; information_audit].

An endpoint-coordinate reward that preserves geometric detail may help transfer the observed shape, pair-kernel and landmark_00 selection pattern into generation. This benefit is a hypothesis; the proxy fields are untyped and do not identify chemical mechanisms or energies [endpoint_effects:3; endpoint_effects:4; endpoint_effects:10; endpoint_effects:14; endpoint_effects:15; information_audit].

If a later comparison investigates regional shaping, use the supplied exact-node empirical support to test a changing geometric preference rather than a monotone global direction. Mid-window enrichment and late attenuation/reversal suggest time-specific hypotheses, but the present evidence does not validate a new schedule, scalar bound, or nodewise sign [regional_curves; regional_effects:0; regional_effects:62; regional_effects:75; curve_support].

Defer a new terminal-survival attractor or general increment-direction reward: corrected survival support is absent, ancestor coverage is sparse, and several level/rate estimands disagree. Keep any paired candidate within the supplied execution contract: zero additional production forward calls per step, FLOWR endpoint VJP, no affinity-head gradient, no SMC, no graph veto, exact learned nodes only and native continuation after the learned window [lineage_support; survival_effects:0; survival_effects:249; regional_effects:49; regional_effects:249; regional_effects:449; increment_effects:15].

counterevidence.finding: Strong integrated directions weaken or reverse near the final observed node, and every audited compact fit fails the runtime fidelity rule. This opposes extrapolating an integrated contrast as a fixed field or inferring support at t=0.5 and later.

Local-selection enrichment does not yield corrected terminal-survival evidence; sparse ancestors and few teachers constrain terminal credit. Neither survival nor missing future labels establishes affinity failure or final quality.

Supported changes in enrichment are not supported parent-edge motion directions for the same fields, and prominent endpoint level associations can have nonsignificant increment contrasts. A general coordinate-velocity policy is unsupported.

Compression changes teacher choice, but excess distance is nonnegative by construction and teacher-score correlations are observational. The audit supplies no causal evidence that either compressed or full coordinates improve final affinity.

The incumbent does not dominate every discovery metric: other programs have smaller reported p90 relief or a better best-valid score. Adaptive reuse and absent paired confidence intervals prevent declaring the small mean differences reliable or establishing the strain constraint.

limitations: Only the request-bound evidence.json was used. Its SHA256 matches the request binding; no referenced source implementation, other variants, external literature or previous conversations were read.

Selection-conditioned endpoint observations are not causal affinity features. The supplied representation is predicted_endpoint_world_A; endpoint-forecast derivatives are not physical atom velocities.

Gaussian regional fields overlap, no atom types are supplied, and compact moments do not recover full coordinates or a unique residue mechanism. Untyped distances do not establish contacts, interactions or energies.

The independent unit is the generation batch, with parent-debiased averaging where specified. Correlated candidates, teachers and repeated descendants must not increase the effective independent sample count.

Empirical node functions have no nodewise uncertainty in the bound evidence. Observed sign reversals are descriptive; exact support stops at t=0.49, and no extrapolation or fitted-curve runtime substitution is justified.

Survival tables concern selection lineage, not terminal affinity effects. Missing future labels remain missing rather than failed affinity. Terminal score time and terminal state time are different clocks.

Discovery quality uses adaptive reused batches, with no independent paired effect intervals, attempt-level failure accounting, absolute strain baseline, or material-regression threshold supplied. The all-attempt affinity objective and strain constraint require validation; they cannot be certified from these summaries.

Exact unit definitions for individual proxy formulas, standardized rate scaling and MMFF relief are not supplied beyond representation/field names. Reported z effects and rate effects should not be translated into physical energies or compared as identical estimands.
